items.title: 15.4 Product ki purity kaise jaanchein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.4, printed page 332.

blocks.text: Aam halaat mein liquid ya solid compounds ko mukhtalif tareeqe saaf karte hain. Liquids aam taur par aam dabao ya vacuum ke tahat distillation se saaf kiye jate hain, aur un ki purity un ke boiling points ko literature ki qeematon se mila kar jaanchi jati hai.

Aspirin, aham dard-kush (analgesic) aur bukhar-kush (antipyretic), salicylic acid ko ghaliz sulfuric acid ke chand qatron ki maujoodgi mein zyada acetic anhydride se react kar ke banai jati hai. Reaction ke baad pani dal kar aspirin precipitate ki jati hai, mixture filter kar ke khaam product milta hai, aur ise polar solvent ke taur par pani se crystallize kiya jata hai.

items: Aspirin bina react hue salicylic acid se mili ho sakti hai. Us ka melting point tay kiya jata hai: agar product teezi se pighle, bilkul 136 degrees C par, to khalis hai; agar yeh darja hararat ki range mein pighle to na-khalis hai.
Mixed melting point: product ko aspirin ke khalis namoone se mila kar melting point tay kiya jata hai; agar yeh ab bhi teez ho to product khalis hai.
Namoone ki khalis aspirin aur khalis salicylic acid ke saath paper chromatography, Rf qeematein milate hue.

blocks.prompt: Melting point purity kaise batata hai, aur aap glucosazone ke laboratory namoone ko kaise jaanchenge (Quick Check 15.5a; exercise Q.2m)?
blocks.explanation: Khalis crystalline solid muqarrar darja hararat par teezi se pighalta hai, jabke na-pakiyan melting point ghata kar range mein phaila deti hain. Glucosazone ko crystallize kiya jayega, us ka melting point le kar literature qeemat se milaya jayega, asli namoone ke saath mixed melting point liya jayega ke woh teez rahe, aur khalis glucosazone ke saath paper chromatogram chalaya jayega ke ek hi Rf ka akela spot ho.

items: Liquids: distil karein, boiling point milayein. Solids (ghaliz H2SO4 ke saath salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride se aspirin): 136 degrees C par teez melting point, teez mixed melting point, ya khalis aspirin aur salicylic acid ke muqable chromatography.
